description: Gym and fitness membership cancellations. Many states have health club-specific statutes providing stronger cancellation rights than general consumer protection law.
typical_barriers: Auto-renewed for another year without notice

email_1.subject: Cancellation of Membership — {{company_name}} — Account: {{account_identifier}}
key_points: Reference to applicable consumer protection law
Request for written confirmation within 7 days
Request to stop all future charges immediately
Note that all previous cancellation attempts are documented

legal_citations.ca: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §17602 (ARL) — if signed up online, must be cancellable online
legal_citations.state_health_club: Reference state-specific health club act if applicable

gym_specific_points: If membership was sold at the gym but terms were accepted digitally, argue online cancellation should be available
Reference specific contract provision being invoked for cancellation
If past minimum commitment, state that the cancellation is post-commitment and no fee applies

email_2.subject: Follow-Up: Cancellation of Membership — {{company_name}} — SECOND REQUEST
key_points: Note any continued charges since first request
Mention intent to file regulatory complaint if not resolved
Mention credit card dispute option for unauthorized charges

email_3.subject: Final Notice: Cancellation of Membership — {{company_name}} — THIRD AND FINAL REQUEST
key_points: Reference both previous emails with dates
State this is a final request
Explicitly name the regulatory body complaint will be filed with
State intent to dispute all charges after cancellation request date with credit card issuer
For CA: reference the 'unconditional gift' provision (§17603) if applicable

CA.statute: Cal. Civ. Code §1812.80-1812.98 (Health Studio Services Contract Law)
key_provisions: Right to cancel within 5 business days of signing
If facility closes or relocates more than 5 miles, right to cancel and get prorated refund
Must provide notice of automatic renewal

NY.statute: N.Y. Gen. Bus. Law §620-627 (Health Club Services Law)
key_provisions: Right to cancel within 3 business days of signing
If member becomes disabled, right to cancel with medical documentation
If facility closes, right to refund
Contract must clearly state cancellation rights
Right to cancel within 3 business days
If member moves more than 25 miles, may cancel with $25 fee or facility transfer
Right to cancel within 3 business days of signing
If facility closes, right to refund within 30 days
Death of member: estate can cancel

notes: Gyms are the highest-volume subscription cancellation vertical. Many consumers don't know about state health club laws that provide stronger protections than general consumer law. The certified-letter requirement (Planet Fitness, etc.) is a common barrier that may violate the FTC click-to-cancel rule if the membership was initiated online.
